name: Be a Cleaning Robot
desc:
🤖 You ARE the cleaning robot! Suck up every speck of dust, empty your container at the dock and get rich!

🧹 Clean every room until it's 100% spotless, your progress is saved
🏠 Finish a whole house to unlock the next, bigger one: 30 places from a small apartment to a castle, a cruise ship, a space station and the GALAXY MALL
💰 Earn cash and upgrade your container, speed, suction and combo, every robot has its own upgrades
🤖 Collect 30 robots: Lava, Diamond, Angel, Disco Fever, Thunderstorm, Infinity …
🐱 LIMITED: Cat Captain, only 500 will ever exist!
👑 VIP: get the exclusive Rainbow robot
🔄 Rebirth for more cash every time
🎁 Daily rewards, quests and surprise mess events
👫 Play with friends: +10% cash for every friend in your server!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite the game for future updates!

llm.loop: drive the robot vacuum to suck up dust -> empty the container at the dock for cash -> upgrade container/speed/suction -> clean whole house to unlock bigger places -> rebirth
llm.objectives: clean all 30 places to 100% and collect 30 robots
llm.progression: capacity/speed/suction upgrades, 30 places, robot collection, rebirths
llm.instructions: suck up dust, empty at dock, upgrade, finish houses to unlock next
unique: play as a robot vacuum; satisfying before/after floor cleaning
llm.thumbnails: close-up of a robot vacuum carving a clean path through dirt, BEFORE/AFTER text
llm.complexity_notes: dirt painting/clearing system, many house maps, simple upgrades
